name: Mandarin Chinese Core
orderingNote: Simplified characters, tone-marked pinyin. Ranks 1-5,000 are ordered by a blend of three frequency corpora (web, subtitles, social media) with a boost for HSK 1-6 vocabulary; names and bound characters removed. Ranks 5,001-10,000 continue the same blend with stricter filters (no proper nouns, slang, measure words, particles or fragments) and include the remaining HSK 2.0 / 3.0 level 1-5 words.

sentences.reading: duō xiè, wǒ zì jǐ lái jiù xíng.
sentences.translation: Thanks, I can manage by myself.

sentences.text: 所有的观众都站起来鼓掌。
sentences.reading: suǒ yǒu de guān zhòng dōu zhàn qǐ lai gǔ zhǎng.
sentences.translation: The whole audience got up and started to applaud.

sentences.reading: wǒ men wèi biǎo yǎn zhě gǔ zhǎng.
sentences.translation: We applauded the performers.

cards.gloss: included; among them (as in 包括…在内 'including')

sentences.text: 包括我在内，一共五个人。
sentences.reading: bāo kuò wǒ zài nèi, yí gòng wǔ gè rén.
sentences.translation: Including me, there are five people in all.

sentences.reading: fáng zū yě suàn zài nèi ma?
sentences.translation: Is the rent included too?

cards.gloss: to set up; to establish; to arrange; (math) let, suppose

sentences.reading: wǒ zhī dào zěn me shè xiàn jǐng.
sentences.translation: I know how to set a trap.

sentences.text: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。
sentences.reading: wǒ men shè le gè xiàn jǐng lái zhuā hú li.
sentences.translation: We set a trap to catch a fox.

cards.gloss: TV or radio presenter; host; anchor

sentences.text: 这位主持人说话很幽默。
sentences.reading: zhè wèi zhǔ chí rén shuō huà hěn yōu mò.
sentences.translation: This host is very humorous.

sentences.text: 你喜欢哪个节目的主持人？
sentences.reading: nǐ xǐ huan nǎ ge jié mù de zhǔ chí rén?
sentences.translation: Which show's host do you like?

sentences.reading: tā shì gōng yè shè jì shī.
sentences.translation: She is an industrial designer.

sentences.text: 她希望成为一名设计师。
sentences.reading: tā xī wàng chéng wéi yì míng shè jì shī.
sentences.translation: She hopes to become a designer.

cards.gloss: to agree on sth (after discussion); to conclude a bargain; to arrange; to promise

sentences.text: 我们约定周末一起去看电影。
sentences.reading: wǒ men yuē dìng zhōu mò yì qǐ qù kàn diàn yǐng.
sentences.translation: We agreed to go see a movie together this weekend.

sentences.text: 你还记得我们的约定吗？
sentences.reading: nǐ hái jì de wǒ men de yuē dìng ma?
sentences.translation: Do you still remember our promise?

cards.gloss: to be defeated; to lose; to defeat; to spoil

sentences.text: 我们队今天败给了他们。
sentences.reading: wǒ men duì jīn tiān bài gěi le tā men.
sentences.translation: Our team lost to them today.

sentences.text: 败了也没关系，下次再来。
sentences.reading: bài le yě méi guān xi, xià cì zài lái.
sentences.translation: It's fine to lose. We'll try again next time.

cards.gloss: rich; wealthy; to be rich in

sentences.reading: tā tǐng fù yǒu.
sentences.translation: She's quite wealthy.

sentences.reading: wǒ gē ge hěn fù yǒu.
sentences.translation: My brother is rich.

cards.gloss: to change direction; to turn; (fig.) to change one's stance

sentences.reading: qì chē zài lù kǒu zhuǎn xiàng yòu bian.
sentences.translation: The car turned right at the intersection.

sentences.text: 公司把重点转向了网上销售。
sentences.reading: gōng sī bǎ zhòng diǎn zhuǎn xiàng le wǎng shàng xiāo shòu.
sentences.translation: The company shifted its focus to online sales.

sentences.reading: zhè běn shū fēi cháng kù.
sentences.translation: This book is so cool.

cards.gloss: yūn: dizzy; to faint, pass out | yùn: dizzy (as in 晕车 carsick); halo

sentences.reading: tā jī hū hē yūn le.
sentences.translation: She was almost dizzy from drinking.

sentences.reading: tā kàn jiàn xuè jiù yūn le.
sentences.translation: She fainted when she saw blood.

sentences.reading: zhè jiàn shì yào xiān wèn wèn shàng jí.
sentences.translation: We need to ask our superiors about this first.

sentences.reading: tā de shàng jí duì tā hěn mǎn yì.
sentences.translation: His boss is very satisfied with him.

cards.gloss: model (particular version of a manufactured article)

sentences.text: 我把充电器的型号记下了。
sentences.reading: wǒ bǎ chōng diàn qì de xíng hào jì xià le.
sentences.translation: I wrote down the model number of the charger.

sentences.reading: tā zhǒng le méi guī.
sentences.translation: She grew roses.

sentences.reading: wǒ xǐ huan hóng sè de méi guī.
sentences.translation: I like red roses.

sentences.reading: nǐ yǒu zhe piào liang de tuǐ.
sentences.translation: You have beautiful legs.

sentences.reading: tā yǒu zhe qí miào de xiǎng fǎ.
sentences.translation: He has wonderful ideas.

cards.gloss: have plenty of; there's no lack of

sentences.text: 别担心，我们有的是时间。
sentences.reading: bié dān xīn, wǒ men yǒu de shì shí jiān.
sentences.translation: Don't worry, we have plenty of time.

sentences.text: 这儿好吃的有的是，你随便挑。
sentences.reading: zhèr hǎo chī de yǒu de shì, nǐ suí biàn tiāo.
sentences.translation: There's plenty of good food here, so take your pick.

sentences.text: 老师一再提醒我们别迟到。
sentences.reading: lǎo shī yí zài tí xǐng wǒ men bié chí dào.
sentences.translation: The teacher repeatedly reminded us not to be late.

sentences.reading: tā yí zài shuō duì bu qǐ.
sentences.translation: He kept saying sorry over and over.

sentences.text: 在教养上，他们可以说是和野蛮人差不多。
sentences.reading: zài jiào yǎng shàng, tā men kě yǐ shuō shì hé yě mán rén chà bu duō.
sentences.translation: In terms of manners, you could say they're not much different from barbarians.

cards.gloss: happy and satisfied; to one's heart's content; straightforward, forthright

sentences.text: 昨天我们玩得特别痛快!
sentences.reading: zuó tiān wǒ men wán de tè bié tòng kuài!
sentences.translation: Yesterday, we had a blast!

sentences.reading: tā shēn qǐng le jiǎng xué jīn.
sentences.translation: He applied for the scholarship.

sentences.text: 她很幸运地赢得了奖学金。
sentences.reading: tā hěn xìng yùn dì yíng dé le jiǎng xué jīn.
sentences.translation: Luckily she won a scholarship.

cards.gloss: for the moment; momentarily; a short while; a period of time

sentences.text: 一时失言常常会带来意想不到的结果。
sentences.reading: yì shí shī yán cháng cháng huì dài lái yì xiǎng bú dào de jié guǒ.
sentences.translation: A slip of the tongue often brings about unexpected results.

sentences.reading: zhǐ róng yì zháo huǒ.
sentences.translation: Paper catches fire easily.

sentences.reading: zháo huǒ le! kuài pǎo a!
sentences.translation: Fire! Run!

sentences.reading: wù jià chí xù shàng zhǎng.
sentences.translation: Prices continued to rise.

sentences.reading: shēng huó zhī chū jí jù shàng zhǎng.
sentences.translation: Living costs have increased rapidly.

sentences.text: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。
sentences.reading: zài xīn jiā pō de jiē dào shàng rēng lā jī huì bèi fá kuǎn.
sentences.translation: They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.

sentences.text: 我喜欢在纽约第五大街购物。
sentences.reading: wǒ xǐ huan zài niǔ yuē dì wǔ dà jiē gòu wù.
sentences.translation: I like shopping on Fifth Avenue in New York.

sentences.text: 澳大利亚是世界第五大煤炭产地。
sentences.reading: ào dà lì yà shì shì jiè dì wǔ dà méi tàn chǎn dì.
sentences.translation: Australia is the world's fifth-largest coal producer.

sentences.reading: tài cán rěn le.
sentences.translation: That's very cruel.

sentences.text: 我从来没想到他能做到那么残忍的事。
sentences.reading: wǒ cóng lái méi xiǎng dào tā néng zuò dào nà me cán rěn de shì.
sentences.translation: I never thought he was capable of doing something so cruel.

cards.gloss: to walk out; to go out of (a room, etc.)

sentences.reading: tā zǒu chū le fáng jiān.
sentences.translation: He walked out of the room.

sentences.text: 我们应该走出什么样的步伐。
sentences.reading: wǒ men yīng gāi zǒu chū shén me yàng de bù fá.
sentences.translation: What steps should we take?

sentences.text: 电脑无疑是一项有价值的工具。
sentences.reading: diàn nǎo wú yí shì yí xiàng yǒu jià zhí de gōng jù.
sentences.translation: The computer is undoubtedly a valuable tool.

sentences.reading: tā zài jiē shang tuī xiāo xīn shǒu jī.
sentences.translation: He is selling new phones on the street.

sentences.text: 这个人很会推销自己的产品。
sentences.reading: zhè ge rén hěn huì tuī xiāo zì jǐ de chǎn pǐn.
sentences.translation: This person is very good at marketing his own products.

sentences.text: 校长向每个毕业生颁发了毕业证书。
sentences.reading: xiào zhǎng xiàng měi gè bì yè shēng bān fā le bì yè zhèng shū.
sentences.translation: The principal presented each of the graduates with a diploma.

cards.gloss: to flow; to circulate; to go from place to place; to be mobile

sentences.reading: hé shuǐ màn màn dì liú dòng.
sentences.translation: The river water flows slowly.

sentences.text: 房间要开窗，让空气流动起来。
sentences.reading: fáng jiān yào kāi chuāng, ràng kōng qì liú dòng qǐ lai.
sentences.translation: Open the window so the air in the room can circulate.

cards.gloss: to shut one's mouth; shut up! (rude)

sentences.reading: wǒ shuō guò le, bì zuǐ!
sentences.translation: I said shut up!

sentences.reading: nǐ kě yǐ bì zuǐ ma?
sentences.translation: Can you please shut up?

sentences.text: 许多电视节目对儿童有不良的影响。
sentences.reading: xǔ duō diàn shì jié mù duì ér tóng yǒu bù liáng de yǐng xiǎng.
sentences.translation: Many TV programs have a bad influence on children.

sentences.reading: huǒ jiàn fā shè jìn rù tài kōng.
sentences.translation: The rocket was launched into space.

sentences.reading: nǐ zuì hǎo děng dào jǐng chá qián lái.
sentences.translation: You'd better wait until the police come.

sentences.text: 她很乐意前来，但是她在休假。
sentences.reading: tā hěn lè yì qián lái, dàn shì tā zài xiū jià.
sentences.translation: She was happy to come, but she was on holiday.

cards.gloss: part (of the body, etc.); position; region

sentences.text: 你身体哪个部位不舒服？
sentences.reading: nǐ shēn tǐ nǎ ge bù wèi bù shū fu?
sentences.translation: Which part of your body feels unwell?

sentences.reading: zhè ge bù wèi yào duō àn yi àn.
sentences.translation: This spot needs more massaging.

cards.gloss: to go on the market (of a new product); to be listed on the stock market

sentences.text: 这家公司在巴黎证券交易所上市了。
sentences.reading: zhè jiā gōng sī zài bā lí zhèng quàn jiāo yì suǒ shàng shì le.
sentences.translation: This company is listed on the Paris stock exchange.

cards.gloss: uncle (friendly address for a man about one's father's age); middle-aged man

sentences.text: 大叔，请问去车站怎么走？
sentences.reading: dà shū, qǐng wèn qù chē zhàn zěn me zǒu?
sentences.translation: Excuse me, sir, how do I get to the station?

sentences.text: 那位大叔在路边卖水果。
sentences.reading: nà wèi dà shū zài lù biān mài shuǐ guǒ.
sentences.translation: That man is selling fruit by the roadside.

cards.gloss: to descend upon; to arrive; to befall

sentences.text: 夜幕降临了，街上亮起了灯。
sentences.reading: yè mù jiàng lín le, jiē shang liàng qǐ le dēng.
sentences.translation: Night fell, and the streetlights came on.

sentences.reading: chūn tiān jiàng lín le, huā dū kāi le.
sentences.translation: Spring has arrived and the flowers are all in bloom.

sentences.text: 你若打算卖掉旧沙发, 何不在本地报纸上登个广告呢?
sentences.reading: nǐ ruò dǎ suàn mài diào jiù shā fā, hé bú zài běn dì bào zhǐ shàng dēng gè guǎng gào ne?
sentences.translation: If you want to sell your old sofa, why not put an advertisement in the local paper?

cards.gloss: to prepare; to make ready; preparation; preparatory

sentences.text: 我本来预备今天去海滩的，但接着天就开始下雨了。
sentences.reading: wǒ běn lái yù bèi jīn tiān qù hǎi tān de, dàn jiē zhe tiān jiù kāi shǐ xià yǔ le.
sentences.translation: I was planning on going to the beach today, but then it started to rain.

cards.gloss: to ride a bike (motorbike or bicycle)

sentences.reading: nǐ bà ba měi tiān qí chē shàng bān.
sentences.translation: Your father rides his bike to work every day.

sentences.reading: tā zǒu lù huò zhě qí chē guò lái.
sentences.translation: He'll come on foot or by bicycle.

cards.gloss: developments; trends; (social media) status update; movement; dynamic

sentences.text: 我常在手机上看朋友的动态。
sentences.reading: wǒ cháng zài shǒu jī shàng kàn péng you de dòng tài.
sentences.translation: I often check my friends' updates on my phone.

sentences.text: 记者一直关注市场的最新动态。
sentences.reading: jì zhě yì zhí guān zhù shì chǎng de zuì xīn dòng tài.
sentences.translation: The reporter keeps following the latest developments in the market.

sentences.text: 这两个国家经常发生边境冲突。
sentences.reading: zhè liǎng gè guó jiā jīng cháng fā shēng biān jìng chōng tū.
sentences.translation: There are often border conflicts between these two countries.

sentences.reading: zhè shì yí zuò biān jìng xiǎo chéng.
sentences.translation: This is a small border town.

sentences.text: 我们能拯救这颗星球吗？
sentences.reading: wǒ men néng zhěng jiù zhè kē xīng qiú ma?
sentences.translation: Can we save the planet?

sentences.text: 不知道别的星球上有没有生物呢？
sentences.reading: bù zhī dào bié de xīng qiú shàng yǒu méi yǒu shēng wù ne?
sentences.translation: I wonder if life exists on other planets.

cards.gloss: sā: to let go; to give vent to (as in 撒谎 to lie) | sǎ: to scatter; to sprinkle; to spill

sentences.reading: shì shí shàng, tā sā huǎng le.
sentences.translation: In fact she lied.

sentences.reading: xiǎn rán tā sā le huǎng.
sentences.translation: It's obvious that he lied.

sentences.reading: nǐ bèi qiǎng jié guò ma?
sentences.translation: Have you ever been robbed?

sentences.reading: bǎ shǒu jǔ qǐ lai! zhè shì qiǎng jié.
sentences.translation: Hands up! This is a robbery.

sentences.reading: nǐ yǒu shén me zhèng zhuàng?
sentences.translation: What symptoms do you have?

sentences.text: 这种症状在我身上将会持续多久？
sentences.reading: zhè zhǒng zhèng zhuàng zài wǒ shēn shang jiāng huì chí xù duō jiǔ?
sentences.translation: For how long will I continue to have these symptoms?

sentences.reading: cǎi hóng yǒu qī zhǒng yán sè.
sentences.translation: A rainbow has seven colors.

sentences.text: 彩虹是自然界最美的现象之一。
sentences.reading: cǎi hóng shì zì rán jiè zuì měi de xiàn xiàng zhī yī.
sentences.translation: A rainbow is one of the most beautiful phenomena of nature.

cards.gloss: tendency; inclination; to be inclined towards

sentences.text: 在我看来，她有一种夸张的倾向。
sentences.reading: zài wǒ kàn lái, tā yǒu yì zhǒng kuā zhāng de qīng xiàng.
sentences.translation: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.

sentences.text: 这台电脑的屏幕很清晰。
sentences.reading: zhè tái diàn nǎo de píng mù hěn qīng xī.
sentences.translation: This computer's screen is very sharp.

cards.gloss: to settle (someone) in; to find a place for; to arrange for

sentences.text: 公司把新同事安置在二楼。
sentences.reading: gōng sī bǎ xīn tóng shì ān zhì zài èr lóu.
sentences.translation: The company put the new colleague on the second floor.

sentences.text: 搬家后，东西都安置好了吗？
sentences.reading: bān jiā hòu, dōng xi dōu ān zhì hǎo le ma?
sentences.translation: After the move, is everything settled in?

cards.gloss: mistake; error; slip; to make a mistake

sentences.reading: tāng mǔ fàn le gè dà shī wù.
sentences.translation: Tom has made a big mistake.

cards.gloss: candle (MW: 根 gēn, 支 zhī)

sentences.reading: kěn diǎn rán le là zhú.
sentences.translation: Ken lit the candles.

sentences.text: 你记得自己该买蜡烛吗？
sentences.reading: nǐ jì de zì jǐ gāi mǎi là zhú ma?
sentences.translation: Did you remember that you were supposed to buy candles?

sentences.reading: bǎo biāo dài zhe ěr jī.
sentences.translation: The bodyguard was wearing an earpiece.

sentences.text: 我温习的时候会戴着耳机听音乐。
sentences.reading: wǒ wēn xí de shí hou huì dài zhe ěr jī tīng yīn yuè.
sentences.translation: When I study, I listen to music with earphones.

sentences.reading: méi yǒu shén me shì shén shèng de.
sentences.translation: Nothing is holy.

sentences.reading: měi tiān dōu shì shén shèng de yì tiān.
sentences.translation: Every day is a sacred day.

cards.gloss: (measure word) for flowers, clouds, etc.; flower; earlobe

sentences.text: 这朵是整个花园最漂亮的花。
sentences.reading: zhè duǒ shì zhěng gè huā yuán zuì piào liang de huā.
sentences.translation: This is the most beautiful flower in the garden.

sentences.reading: zhè shì duǒ rén zào huā.
sentences.translation: It's an artificial flower.

sentences.reading: shàng kè yào zūn shǒu jì lǜ.
sentences.translation: You must follow the rules in class.

sentences.reading: zhè ge bān de jì lǜ hěn hǎo.
sentences.translation: This class is very well disciplined.

sentences.reading: tā men tán lùn le ài qíng.
sentences.translation: They talked about love.

sentences.reading: wǒ bù xiǎng tán lùn tiān qì.
sentences.translation: I don't want to talk about the weather.

sentences.reading: tā men kě néng zài děng jiāo jǐng ba.
sentences.translation: They're probably waiting for the traffic police.

sentences.reading: zhè ge qì qiú bèi shù guà zhù le.
sentences.translation: The balloon was caught in the tree.

sentences.reading: wǒ shì yǎn yuán, bú shì mó tè.
sentences.translation: I'm an actress, not a model.

sentences.reading: tóng xìng liàn bù shi yì zhǒng bìng.
sentences.translation: Being gay is not an illness.

sentences.text: 她在报纸上读到一篇关于同性恋的文章。
sentences.reading: tā zài bào zhǐ shàng dú dào yì piān guān yú tóng xìng liàn de wén zhāng.
sentences.translation: She read an article about homosexuality in the newspaper.

sentences.reading: zhè ge chéng bǎo hǎo měi.
sentences.translation: The castle is beautiful.

sentences.reading: wǒ hé mèi mei qù le chéng bǎo.
sentences.translation: My sister and I went to the castle.

sentences.reading: tā dāng rán shì wú gū de.
sentences.translation: Of course he's innocent.

sentences.reading: wèi shén me nǐ jiǎ zhuāng wú gū!
sentences.translation: Why are you feigning innocence!

cards.gloss: to neglect; to overlook; to ignore

sentences.reading: wǒ hū lüè le shì shí.
sentences.translation: I overlooked the fact.

sentences.text: 如果我是你，我就忽略它。
sentences.reading: rú guǒ wǒ shì nǐ, wǒ jiù hū lüè tā.
sentences.translation: If I were you, I would ignore it.

sentences.reading: tā men de shēng huó hěn tián mì.
sentences.translation: Their life together is very sweet.

sentences.reading: tā xiào de hěn tián mì.
sentences.translation: She smiled sweetly.

cards.gloss: to change; to switch; to convert; to transform

sentences.reading: qǐng bǎ dān wèi zhuǎn huàn yí xià.
sentences.translation: Please convert the units.

sentences.reading: nǐ kě yǐ zhuǎn huàn yí xià xīn qíng.
sentences.translation: You could try to change your mood.

sentences.reading: nǐ zài sā huǎng.
sentences.translation: You are lying.

sentences.reading: tā yīng gāi méi sā huǎng.
sentences.translation: She probably didn't lie.

cards.gloss: to suppose; to presume; to assume; supposing that ...

sentences.reading: zhè zhǐ shì gè jiǎ shè.
sentences.translation: This is just a hypothesis.

sentences.reading: tā jiǎ shè tā shì wú gū de.
sentences.translation: She presumes him to be innocent.

cards.gloss: generous; natural and poised (not shy or stingy); tasteful

sentences.reading: nǐ tài dà fang le.
sentences.translation: You're too generous.

sentences.reading: tā dà fang de dào qiàn.
sentences.translation: She apologized graciously.

sentences.text: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。
sentences.reading: yín háng duì fēng xiǎn kè hù shōu qǔ jiào gāo de dài kuǎn lì xī.

sentences.translation: The defense of the master's thesis is next month.

sentences.translation: Life is truly wondrous!

sentences.translation: What's your schedule for tomorrow?

sentences.translation: Give a lecture on literature.

sentences.translation: He is playing music.

sentences.translation: Do you play a musical instrument?

sentences.reading: nǐ kě yǐ zì jǐ tiáo jié kōng tiáo de wēn dù.
sentences.translation: You can adjust the air conditioner's temperature yourself.

sentences.reading: shuì qián tīng yīn yuè néng bāng nǐ tiáo jié xīn qíng.
sentences.translation: Listening to music before bed can help you regulate your mood.

cards.gloss: to control; to have in hand; to be in command of

sentences.reading: tā zǒng xiǎng zhǎng kòng yí qiè, dà jiā dōu hěn lèi.
sentences.translation: He always wants to control everything, and everyone is worn out.

sentences.text: 开车的时候，你一定要掌控好速度。

sentences.translation: When driving, you must keep your speed under control.

sentences.translation: She is wearing a gold ring on her hand.

sentences.translation: He won a gold medal in the competition.

sentences.translation: There are many jobs available in the computer industry.

cards.gloss: title (of honor); designation; term of address

sentences.translation: Because he worked so hard, he earned the title of outstanding student.

sentences.translation: Do you know what title this city has?

sentences.translation: Please tell him that tomorrow's meeting has been moved to the afternoon.

sentences.translation: Mom asked me to tell you to come home early for dinner.

cards.gloss: to arrive; to approach; to be at hand

sentences.translation: Cold winter has arrived.

sentences.translation: On behalf of the company, I welcome you.

sentences.translation: I cannot visit you every day.

sentences.reading: xià zhōu wǒ men yào qù kàn wàng wǒ men de lǎo shī.
sentences.translation: We will visit our teacher next week.

cards.gloss: minister (of a monarchy or imperial court); cabinet minister

sentences.translation: In ancient times, ministers had to attend court every morning.

sentences.translation: This minister gave the king a good piece of advice.

sentences.reading: yí gè rén pǎo le yī bǎi gōng lǐ, zhēn bù kě sī yì!
sentences.translation: One person ran a hundred kilometers. It's incredible!

sentences.reading: zhè jiàn shì tīng qǐ lai bù kě sī yì, dàn shì zhēn de.
sentences.translation: This sounds unbelievable, but it's true.

sentences.text: 你曾是一宗司法案件的证人？
sentences.reading: nǐ céng shì yì zōng sī fǎ àn jiàn de zhèng rén?
sentences.translation: Have you ever served as a witness in a court case?

cards.gloss: to give instructions; to hand over (duties); to explain; to confess

sentences.reading: bǎ mǎ lì jiāo dài nǐ qù zuò de shì gào su tāng mǔ.
sentences.translation: Tell Tom what Mary asked you to do.

cards.gloss: will; is going to (formal future marker)

sentences.reading: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ men jiāng huì zuò shén me.
sentences.translation: I don't know what we'll do.

sentences.reading: gù shi lǐ yǒu yí gè měi lì de xiǎo wáng guó.
sentences.translation: In the story, there is a beautiful little kingdom.

sentences.text: 这个广告的口号很容易记住。

sentences.translation: This ad's slogan is easy to remember.

sentences.translation: My uncle made me serve as interpreter.

sentences.translation: Environmental pollution can have an enormous impact on the ecology of a region.

sentences.translation: This company has expanded very fast in recent years.

sentences.translation: He is very hard on lazy people.

sentences.translation: Her remarks aroused public discontent.

sentences.translation: I am completely unable to accept this envoy's remarks.

sentences.translation: The defendant is due to appear in court on Friday.

sentences.translation: I hear you've already been in touch with the agency.

sentences.translation: Everyone's dignity should be respected.

sentences.text: 男孩子喜欢玩坦克玩具。
sentences.reading: nán hái zi xǐ huan wán tǎn kè wán jù.
sentences.translation: Boys like playing with toy tanks.

sentences.text: 博物馆里停着一辆旧坦克。
sentences.reading: bó wù guǎn lǐ tíng zhe yí liàng jiù tǎn kè.
sentences.translation: An old tank is parked in the museum.

sentences.text: 他想找一个合适的人生伴侣。
sentences.reading: tā xiǎng zhǎo yí gè hé shì de rén shēng bàn lǚ.
sentences.translation: He wants to find a suitable life partner.

sentences.text: 小狗是老人最好的伴侣。
sentences.reading: xiǎo gǒu shì lǎo rén zuì hǎo de bàn lǚ.
sentences.translation: A little dog is an elderly person's best companion.

sentences.text: 我们过着十分平凡的生活。
sentences.reading: wǒ men guò zhe shí fēn píng fán de shēng huó.
sentences.translation: We lead a very ordinary life.

sentences.text: 生活真正的艺术是在平凡中看到不平凡。
sentences.reading: shēng huó zhēn zhèng de yì shù shì zài píng fán zhōng kàn dào bù píng fán.
sentences.translation: True art of life is to see the extraordinary amongst the ordinary.

sentences.reading: jiā zhù shì shǐ dài mǎ gēng yì dú.
sentences.translation: Adding comments makes the code easier to read.

sentences.text: 对现有代码做出任何修改前，你需要考虑后果。
sentences.reading: duì xiàn yǒu dài mǎ zuò chū rèn hé xiū gǎi qián, nǐ xū yào kǎo lǜ hòu guǒ.
sentences.translation: You need to consider the consequences before making any modifications to existing code.

cards.gloss: to take the lead; to show initiative

sentences.text: 小明率先举手回答问题。
sentences.reading: xiǎo míng shuài xiān jǔ shǒu huí dá wèn tí.
sentences.translation: Xiaoming was the first to raise his hand to answer.

sentences.text: 我们公司率先用上了新技术。
sentences.reading: wǒ men gōng sī shuài xiān yòng shàng le xīn jì shù.
sentences.translation: Our company was the first to adopt the new technology.

sentences.text: 每个人都有他的长处和短处。
sentences.reading: měi gè rén dōu yǒu tā de cháng chù hé duǎn chù.
sentences.translation: Everyone has strengths and weaknesses.

cards.gloss: chief; principal; top-ranking (e.g. first-chair player, chief designer)

sentences.text: 她是乐队的首席小提琴手。
sentences.reading: tā shì yuè duì de shǒu xí xiǎo tí qín shǒu.
sentences.translation: She is the principal violinist of the orchestra.

sentences.text: 他是公司的首席设计师。
sentences.reading: tā shì gōng sī de shǒu xí shè jì shī.
sentences.translation: He is the company's chief designer.

cards.gloss: slightly; roughly; brief; outline; to omit

sentences.reading: tā de gè zi bǐ wǒ lüè gāo.
sentences.translation: He is slightly taller than me.

sentences.text: 这两个杯子大小略有不同。
sentences.reading: zhè liǎng gè bēi zi dà xiǎo lüè yǒu bù tóng.
sentences.translation: These two cups differ slightly in size.

sentences.reading: gōng sī juǎn rù le yì cháng sù sòng.
sentences.translation: The company got caught up in a lawsuit.

sentences.text: 这场诉讼花了他很多钱。
sentences.reading: zhè chǎng sù sòng huā le tā hěn duō qián.
sentences.translation: This lawsuit cost him a lot of money.

sentences.reading: tā xǐ huan tīng yáo gǔn yuè.
sentences.translation: He likes listening to rock music.

sentences.text: 我哥哥组了一个摇滚乐队。
sentences.reading: wǒ gē ge zǔ le yí gè yáo gǔn yuè duì.
sentences.translation: My older brother started a rock band.

sentences.text: 我以身为这个计划的一份子为荣。
sentences.reading: wǒ yǐ shēn wéi zhè ge jì huà de yí fèn zi wèi róng.
sentences.translation: I am proud to be a part of this project.

cards.gloss: to witness; to bear witness to; witness; testimony

sentences.text: 我很高兴见证你的成长。
sentences.reading: wǒ hěn gāo xìng jiàn zhèng nǐ de chéng zhǎng.
sentences.translation: I'm so happy to witness you growing up.

sentences.text: 这座老桥见证了城市的变化。
sentences.reading: zhè zuò lǎo qiáo jiàn zhèng le chéng shì de biàn huà.
sentences.translation: This old bridge has witnessed the city's changes.

cards.gloss: post office (MW: 家 jiā, 个 gè)

sentences.reading: yóu jú zài nǎr?
sentences.translation: Where's the post office?

sentences.reading: zhè lǐ yǐ qián yǒu yóu jú.
sentences.translation: There used to be a post office here.

cards.gloss: to allocate; to manage (money, time); to have at one's disposal; to control

sentences.text: 这笔钱你可以自由支配。
sentences.reading: zhè bǐ qián nǐ kě yǐ zì yóu zhī pèi.
sentences.translation: You can spend this money however you like.

sentences.text: 你要学会合理支配时间。
sentences.reading: nǐ yào xué huì hé lǐ zhī pèi shí jiān.
sentences.translation: You need to learn to manage your time sensibly.

sentences.translation: Instead of him, my brother was arrested.

sentences.reading: tā yīn jiǔ hòu jià shǐ ér bèi bǔ.
sentences.translation: He was arrested for drunken driving.

cards.gloss: a whole outfit; one's whole body; all over; from head to toe

sentences.reading: tā zǒng shì yì shēn hēi.
sentences.translation: She is always dressed in black.

sentences.text: 这些花生长在温暖的国家。
sentences.reading: zhè xiē huā shēng zhǎng zài wēn nuǎn de guó jiā.
sentences.translation: These peanuts grow in warm countries.

sentences.text: 饼干中可能含有坚果或花生，即使没被列入原料配方中。
sentences.reading: bǐng gān zhōng kě néng hán yǒu jiān guǒ huò huā shēng, jí shǐ méi bèi liè rù yuán liào pèi fāng zhōng.
sentences.translation: Cookies may contain nuts or peanuts, even if not included in the ingredient list.

sentences.reading: wǒ men xǐ huan yuè dú shū jí.
sentences.translation: We enjoy reading books.

sentences.reading: jī hū méi yǒu rèn hé shū jí.
sentences.translation: There are almost no books.

sentences.reading: nǐ shì gè měi rén.
sentences.translation: You're a beautiful woman.

sentences.reading: tā shì yí wèi zhēn zhèng de měi rén.
sentences.translation: She is a real beauty.

sentences.text: 他是我最好的工作搭档。
sentences.reading: tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de gōng zuò dā dàng.
sentences.translation: He is my best work partner.

sentences.reading: nǐ yuàn yì hé wǒ dā dàng ma?
sentences.translation: Would you like to team up with me?

sentences.text: 这种花的生长周期很短。
sentences.reading: zhè zhǒng huā de shēng zhǎng zhōu qī hěn duǎn.
sentences.translation: The growth cycle of this flower is very short.

sentences.reading: shǒu jī gēng xīn de zhōu qī yuè lái yuè duǎn.
sentences.translation: The cycle between phone upgrades keeps getting shorter.

sentences.translation: The snow was knee deep.

sentences.translation: He got wet from the waist to the knees.

sentences.reading: yuè qiú shàng méi yǒu kōng qì.
sentences.translation: There is no air on the moon.

sentences.text: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
sentences.reading: nǐ kě yǐ xiǎng xiàng zài yuè qiú shàng xíng zǒu ma?
sentences.translation: Can you imagine walking around on the moon?

cards.gloss: to deceive; to lie to people; to cheat

sentences.translation: Why do you lie?

sentences.reading: wǒ méi yǒu tīng guò tā piàn rén.
sentences.translation: I have never heard him lie.

cards.gloss: to step across; to stride over; to straddle; to span

sentences.translation: Please do not step over this line.

sentences.translation: A car should turn slowly at an intersection.

sentences.text: 你在前面第二个路口转弯。
sentences.reading: nǐ zài qián miàn dì èr gè lù kǒu zhuǎn wān.
sentences.translation: Turn at the second intersection up ahead.

cards.gloss: plan; scheme; trick; to calculate; to count

sentences.translation: Crap! I fell for his trap!

sentences.translation: The teacher read out the names one by one.

sentences.reading: qǐng nǐ bǎ wèn tí yī yī huí dá.
sentences.translation: Please answer the questions one by one.

sentences.translation: He isn't going to buy a video camera.

sentences.reading: wǒ dì di shǒu lǐ ná zhe yí gè shè xiàng jī.
sentences.translation: My younger brother is holding a video camera in his hand.

sentences.translation: You can't avoid official policy.

sentences.translation: Yoko avoided answering my question.

sentences.translation: Brush your teeth.

sentences.translation: You guys need to go brush your teeth!

sentences.translation: He works at a real estate company.

sentences.translation: The real estate business has been tough these past few years.

sentences.translation: Tom was unhappy because she never asked for his opinion.

cards.gloss: to wash; to clean; to purge

sentences.reading: qǐng qīng xǐ tā.
sentences.translation: Please wash it.

sentences.translation: Wash up.

sentences.translation: I think of his name every time I hear this song.

sentences.translation: No wonder we associate bats with dark places.

sentences.translation: This pillow is filled with cotton.

sentences.reading: qiū tiān, tián lǐ de mián hua kāi le.
sentences.translation: In autumn, the cotton in the fields blooms.

sentences.translation: We are on strike.

sentences.reading: tā men yǐ jīng qǔ xiāo le bà gōng.
sentences.translation: They already called off the strike.

sentences.translation: He gave my hand a gentle squeeze.

sentences.reading: mā ma yòng miàn tuán niē le yì zhī xiǎo tù zi.
sentences.translation: Mom molded a little rabbit out of dough.

sentences.text: 我的一个朋友委托一位知名画家给他的妻子画肖像。
sentences.reading: wǒ de yí gè péng you wěi tuō yí wèi zhī míng huà jiā gěi tā de qī zǐ huà xiào xiàng.
sentences.translation: A friend of mine commissioned a well-known artist to paint a portrait of his wife.

sentences.translation: She is full of potential.

sentences.reading: tā yǒu jí dà de qián lì.
sentences.translation: He has enormous potential.

sentences.reading: tā yǐ tā zǔ fù de míng zi bèi mìng míng.
sentences.translation: He was named after his grandfather.

sentences.translation: Father named me after his aunt.

sentences.translation: Eggplant, carrot, tomato.

sentences.reading: tā zài tā huā yuán lǐ zhǒng xī hóng shì.
sentences.translation: She grows tomatoes in her garden.

sentences.reading: zhè xiàng jì shù yǐ jīng shēn qǐng le zhuān lì.
sentences.translation: A patent has already been applied for on this technology.

sentences.reading: zhè ge fā míng yǒu zhuān lì ma?
sentences.translation: Does this invention have a patent?

cards.gloss: to accompany; to follow; to occur together with; concomitant

sentences.reading: shǎn diàn cháng cháng bàn suí zhe léi míng.
sentences.translation: Lightning is often accompanied by thunder.

sentences.translation: Please make three copies of each page.

sentences.reading: zhè shì yì qǐ xíng shì àn jiàn.
sentences.translation: This is a criminal case.

sentences.text: 他的律师专门处理刑事案件。
sentences.reading: tā de lǜ shī zhuān mén chǔ lǐ xíng shì àn jiàn.
sentences.translation: His lawyer specializes in handling criminal cases.

cards.gloss: to go out; to go away (on a trip etc)

sentences.translation: Jane is out shopping.

sentences.text: 我曾经每周末都和朋友外出。
sentences.reading: wǒ céng jīng měi zhōu mò dōu hé péng you wài chū.
sentences.translation: I used to go out with friends every weekend.

sentences.reading: zài wú míng zhàn shì de mù qián xiàn shàng le xiān huā hé huā quān.
sentences.translation: Flowers and wreaths were laid in front of the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

sentences.translation: He caught me by the arm.

sentences.reading: yǒu rén zhuā zhù le wǒ de shǒu bì.
sentences.translation: Somebody caught me by the arm.

sentences.reading: jīng guò màn cháng de lǚ chéng, wǒ men zhōng yú dào le.
sentences.translation: After a long journey we finally arrived.

sentences.reading: wǒ men cháng cháng bǎ rén shēng bǐ zuò yì cháng lǚ chéng.
sentences.translation: Life is often compared to a journey.

sentences.reading: xià kè hòu, tóng xué men dōu bēn xiàng shí táng.
sentences.translation: After class, the students all rushed to the cafeteria.

sentences.reading: tā jí zhe bēn huí jiā.
sentences.translation: He hurried home in a rush.

sentences.reading: tā yǒu yǒng qì qù chá xún kǎo shì de jié guǒ.
sentences.translation: She had the courage to go and inquire about the results of the exam.

sentences.translation: He is the company's technical director.

sentences.translation: The director has a meeting this afternoon.

sentences.reading: jiù yuán duì hěn kuài gǎn dào le xiàn chǎng.
sentences.translation: The rescue team arrived at the scene quickly.

sentences.reading: dà yǔ guò hòu, dà jiā yì qǐ cān jiā jiù yuán.
sentences.translation: After the heavy rain, everyone joined the rescue effort.

sentences.translation: The rioters were forcibly removed from the plaza.

sentences.translation: I got a bee sting.

sentences.translation: My underwear is dirty.

sentences.reading: zhèng qián róng yì zǎn qián nán.
sentences.translation: It is easier to get money than to keep it.

sentences.reading: niǎor gē chàng.
sentences.translation: Birds sing.

sentences.reading: chú wǒ yǐ wài měi gè rén dōu zài gē chàng.
sentences.translation: Everybody was singing except me.

sentences.translation: Don't be picky about gifts people give you, complaining about this and that.

sentences.translation: The police accused him of murder.

sentences.translation: We go to the same school.
